name: a weekly summary card rolls up its total
looks: A headline names the recap. A card beneath it holds a date range, a big number rolling up to the week's total, and a short set of labelled bars growing from a baseline to show the mix behind that total.
build: The big number rolls up under a slight vertical blur tied to its speed; the bars grow scaleY 0 -> 1 from a bottom origin on an uneven stagger, same mechanic as data-infographic's bar build.
sound: A rising tone under the number roll-up and a soft tick per bar growing.
prompt: Name a weekly recap, then roll up a big total number on a summary card, followed by a short set of labelled bars growing from a baseline on an uneven stagger to show what made up that total.
